html:
Question 1
?

Find and categorize all the local extrema of the function f(x,y) given that f′(x,y)=[4x2y2−2].

a
f(x,y) has a local minimum at (0,0)
b
f(x,y) has a saddle point at (0,−1) and a local minimum at (0,1)
c
f(x,y) has a local minimum at (0,0) and a saddle point at (1,1)
d
f(x,y) has a local maximum at (−1,0) and a local minimum at (0,1)
e
f(x,y) has a local maximum at (0,0) and a local minimum at (1,−1)
Submit
